posts.text: The blockclock FUD is completely ridiculous. Yes it makes a connection to the internet to find things out about bitcoin (note: bitcoin is on the internet). Yes it has your WiFi password . It's probably as insecure as any other IOT device on your network.

posts.author: mutatrum
posts.name: mutatrum
posts.text: If there's even a small possibility it was malice, it's not like any other it device.
